text: Hey, Lukas. Got a minute? I was at the counter just now and heard your little story about the guy who missed an empty net from three meters. Was that supposed to be me?

Hey Daniel. No, that wasn’t about you at all. I was talking about this viral video from the Bundesliga last week. Didn’t even cross my mind that it would sound like I was talking about someone from our team.
Really? Because your friends laughed like they knew exactly who you meant. I’m not stupid, Lukas. If you want to make a joke at my expense, just say it to my face next time.
If I wanted to make fun of you, I would have. I don’t hide behind stories. I was just telling them about the video, end of story. You can believe it or not, that’s up to you.

Alright, I mean, maybe I got the wrong impression. It just sounded pretty clear from where I was standing, but if you say it wasn’t about me, fine. I just didn’t like being laughed at like that, you know?

I get that, but honestly, it wasn’t aimed at you. I don’t see the point in dragging teammates down, especially after a tough loss. If something bothers you next time, just ask straight away. No point letting it build up.
Yeah, fair enough. I’ll keep that in mind. Just didn’t expect to hear that right after the match, you know? Whatever, let’s just drop it. Got your drink, or are you still waiting?
I’ve got my drink, thanks. If you want to sit, go ahead. No hard feelings from my side. If you want to talk about the match or anything else, I’m here. Up to you.
